purpose: Exact legacy and post-fix characterization; organizational extraction must preserve record digests on the same runtime.

gym.action_rule: Repeat the listed discrete action cycle for 12 steps, stopping on termination/truncation.
gym.note: ode_noise_off only disables NoiseConfig; controller acceptance/action randomness remains unchanged. Exercise is absent from the public Gym action space.

acceptance.extraction: All record SHA256 digests, structure, dtype, numerical bytes, PRNG keys, discrete events and public outputs equal; pinned runtime metadata equal.
acceptance.cache_fix: Cold and repeat_same_seed runtime/trajectory records equal legacy; after_other_seed may change and must equal the post-fix cold record. Separate regression tests verify real cache hits and seed=None progression.
acceptance.getter_fix: Only exposed parameter records may differ; compare their digests against separately captured effective parameters for every repaired Gym record. Runtime trajectory records remain subject to cache rules.
acceptance.compilation_changes: Numerical kernels and JIT boundaries unchanged; harness compilation caches are released between capture groups. No numerical tolerance substitution.
acceptance.platform: CPU; record Python, JAX, jaxlib, NumPy, platform and x64 settings; refuse cross-runtime comparison.
